title: Paradise Cabin Near Nashville Lic:  0135569
description:
This rehabbed civil war cabin on 14 acres of woods in Goodletsville, TN.  This 3,026 SF hidden gem is surrounded by nature is located 25 mins from Downtown Nash, the Grand Ole Opry & Nissan Stadium.  This  cabin has 3 bedrooms, 3 remodeled full baths, dining room, stone fireplace, office/bonus room with queen and twin bunkbeds, hardwood floors throughout, and a swimming pool, hot tub and barbecue along with oversized jacuzzi tub in master bath and a steam room shower in main floor bath

The space
Living room includes a big screen Smart TV
Full size washer/dryer is located in kitchen utility closet
Main level bathroom is also a steam room
Master bathroom includes jacuzzi
Kitchen is stocked with cooking utensils and dinnerware
Coffee, paper towels and toilet paper will be provided
Charcoal BBQ grill is located in swimming pool area
Towels for the swimming pool are located in bathroom on the main floor
Fire pit is located in the swimming pool area

Guest access
Guests will have access to entire property with the exception of the garage/storage unit located in the backyard behind the swimming pool.

Other things to note
This special property was the set of Dan & Shays 2021 Christmas video (Officially Christmas) and truly is a great Christmas/New Years retreat.
